name: Nidhi Garga

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nidhi Garg brings together poetry, counselling psychology and participation in Bhubaneswar's literary life. Prabha Khaitan Foundation records her work with Ehsaas Women of Bhubaneswar, including introducing poet Pradeep Biswal at an Aakhar discussion. Centurion University also records her participation as a counsellor and psychologist in a 2024 public-awareness panel.

‘Nights’ gives form to an inward conversation that will not grow quiet. Questions of belonging and purpose return as the speaker tries to push difficult thoughts away. Tears, a pounding heart and troubled breathing make that unease physically present; the poem closes with the questions still unresolved.
